name: Monocular Depth Consistency Loss
definition: A loss function that enforces consistency between estimated depth D_hat(r) and predicted monocular depth D_bar(r) using a closed-form least-squares solution for scale and shift parameters, calculated per batch.
summary: Monocular Depth Consistency Loss enforces geometric consistency between rendered depth and monocular priors by explicitly modeling their affine relationship via a closed-form least-squares solution, unlike semantic or distributional methods.
